metric_definition: Finest-lattice source-defined curvature-weighted circular MRF and final-rate complex variable-projection SSE, each divided by full observed complex signal norm squared. Independently profiled coefficients determine submitted amplitudes; fraction consistency is absolute percentage points.
tolerance_provenance: Predeclared 1e-6 normalized objective allowances and numerical coefficient/fraction tolerances; not measured noise or true fat-fraction accuracy.
reference_role: Attainable discrete conditional field/decay fit, not biological truth.
